The closest match is [1], which is by Shutong Qiao and coauthors and proposes variable-length, LLM-aligned semantic identifiers for generative recommendation. [1] It directly targets adaptive SID lengths and says the identifiers are built from native LLM vocabulary tokens to better fit item semantic complexity. [1]

A related earlier paper is [8], also by Shutong Qiao and coauthors, but it studies how to improve Semantic ID learning by using OCR-based text representations rather than standard text embeddings. [8] It does not address variable-length semantic IDs. [8]
